newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Twenty-two killed in south Philippines fighting.
newsitem.headline: Twenty-two killed in south Philippines fighting.

text.p: Philippine troops backed by helicopter gunships killed at least 20 Moslem rebels in fierce fighting on southern Mindanao island, the military said on Wednesday.

Two soldiers were killed and four others were wounded in the fighting that erupted on Tuesday around the town of Buldon in Maguindanao province, about 800 km (500 miles) south of Manila, an official military report said.
The fighting involved hundreds of soldiers and an estimated 400 guerrillas of the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), which has been fighting for an Islamic state in Mindanao and adjacent islands.
The figure on rebel casualties was based on a body count, military spokesman Major Teddy Covarubias told reporters at the regional military headquarters in southern Zamboanga city.
Soldiers also recovered more than a dozen assault rifles from the rebels, he said.

The MILF is a breakaway faction of the mainstream Moro National Liberation Front, which concluded a peace deal with President Fidel Ramos's government in October last year. The MILF is not a party to the deal but recently held preliminary talks with a government panel on ending their own rebellion.
